subject: Request: temporary PO deferment for PolarisForge integration
messages:
From: Jordan Le <jordan.le@polarisforge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@polarisforge.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary PO deferment for PolarisForge integration

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product integration looks solid and we
are excited to start a trial with Redwood. One procurement point on our side:
PolarisForge bills monthly via our billing API and we do not issue purchase
orders for platform SaaS in our current workflow.

Would Redwood consider a temporary "no-PO" onboarding for a 60-day pilot so
we can validate usage patterns and get billing exercised? We can provide a
vendor W‑9 and a short risk profile. If helpful, we are open to a single
invoice pre-approved by Redwood finance each month and a short addendum that
limits liability for the pilot.

Attachments: Polaris_W9.pdf (stub), Polaris-risk-profile.xlsx (stub)

Next steps from our side: if this is acceptable in principle, I can send a
one-page note from procurement confirming the temporary arrangement and the
primary billing contact.

Best,
Jordan Le
Head of Ops, PolarisForge
---
PolarisForge | polarisforge.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Le <jordan.le@polarisforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO deferment for PolarisForge integration

Jordan — thanks for the note and the artifacts. Appreciate the quick follow up.

Short answer: we can consider a conditional, timeboxed deferment for a pilot,
but need to validate a few controls with Finance and Sales first. Proposed
minimal checklist for approval:

- Confirmed vendor identity + W‑9 on file (received).
- Billing contact and monthly invoice cadence (you mentioned monthly).
- Pilot threshold (suggest a $10k/month cap to start).
- Evidence of SOC2 or equivalent? If not, compensating controls (limited
  invoice cap + shorter retention).
- A one-page addendum signed by both sides that explicitly limits the
  deferment to 60 days and defines the invoice contact.

If Polaris can confirm the monthly invoice contact and accept a $10k pilot
cap, I will loop in David in Finance and Marissa on Commercial to run the
approval and draft the addendum.

Can you confirm by EOD tomorrow? If yes, I’ll start the internal approval
thread and propose a one-page addendum template.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Manager, GTM Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO deferment for PolarisForge integration

Sofia / David — quick internal take from Commercial:

- Commercial ok with a short pilot without PO if Finance signs off on the
  controls (invoice cap + short duration). We prefer a 30‑day pilot to reduce
  exposure, but can be flexible to 60 days with increased monitoring.
- Sales asks to keep usage metering enabled and share weekly usage reports
  so we can proactively surface overages before invoice generation.
- Suggestion: conditional allowlist entry for Polaris that auto-revokes at the
  end date unless Finance approves extension.

David — can you confirm if Finance can approve a 30-day $10k cap vs a
60-day $10k cap with a weekly usage check-in? Also flag any tax or 3rd-party
issues we should consider.

I can draft the one-page addendum and the usage reporting template once we
land on duration/cap.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Le <jordan.le@polarisforge.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO deferment for PolarisForge integration

Jordan — thanks for the documentation. Finance can approve a conditional
no-PO pilot with the following binding conditions:

1) Duration: 30 days initial pilot (we can extend to 60 days pending a mid-
   pilot review).
2) Invoice cap: $10,000 total for the pilot period. Any expected overage
   requires written pre-approval from Redwood Finance.
3) Billing contact: procurement@polarisforge.com (we need the primary billing
   contact name and phone on file).
4) Reporting: weekly usage snapshot to finance@redwood.com and a final
   reconciliation invoice within 7 days of pilot end.
5) Addendum: sign the attached one-page addendum that limits the pilot and
   includes the $10k cap and termination on end date.
6) Tax/docs: we have the W‑9 on file. No further tax docs required for this
   pilot.

Attached: Redwood-conditional-MSA-signed.pdf (stub) — this is the one-page
addendum template with the pilot cap filled in. Please sign via the link
below or return a signed PDF.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/abcdef-12345

If you accept these terms, reply and include the billing contact + phone and
we'll provision PolarisForge to the allowlist and enable usage metering.

Thanks,
David Kim
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
